answer: Use tiered admission terraces with random audit lotteries: a new agent starts on a low terrace with capped transaction volume and must post a refundable bond. A rotating jury of established agents spot-audits its work at unpredictable times, like a comet flashing across the sky rather than a steady zephyr breeze. Passing audits over weeks raises its terrace; failing one burns the bond and ejects the identity. Forging 1,000 Sybils then means funding 1,000 bonds and surviving 1,000 independent audit lotteries, which costs far more than the identities could extract.
